summary: No covering test rejects the 'empty evidence' counterexample: the REQ-013.1.2 case matrix (tests/evidence-groups.test.ts:88-94) covers missing tests/evidence and empty tests only, never evidence: [] with tests present, so that conjunct of the requirement is unverified by tests; additionally the unit 'naming the group' assertion is a disjunctive /storage|evidence_groups/ regex that would pass a group-name-less error (gate-level naming is asserted only for the missing-evidence cell).
